description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム』より、1/100スケールで、アッガイが登場。
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam", Acguy appears in 1/100 scale.

description.ja: 頭部は別パーツで可動します。クローの開閉と腕の伸縮が再現されています。股関節は左右に開閉し、ハの字に開くこともできます。足首が前後左右にスイングします。
description.en: The head is a separate part that can be moved. The opening and closing of the claw and the extension and contraction of the arms are reproduced. The hip joints can be opened and closed to the left and right, and can also be opened in a V-shape. The ankle swings back and forth and left and right.
